name: Hacker News Search
label: Hacker News (Algolia) - Developer Community Search
description: Search Hacker News stories and comments via the free HN Algolia API at http://hn.algolia.com/api/v1 (http, not https). No authentication and no API key — the Java handler does not send a User-Agent (matching the Python node). EXACT actions: 'search' (default, relevance) | 'search_by_date' (recency, most recent first). Unknown actions still call GET /search. Tag filter defaults to 'story'; also comment, show_hn, ask_hn, poll, front_page, author_USERNAME, story_ID, and AND/OR combinations. Pagination is 0-indexed; hits_per_page is capped at 50. Algolia generally exposes only the first 1,000 hits per query — use created_at_i numericFilters for time-windowed monitoring. Errors land on output.error; there is no separate error port.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Hacker News Algolia search. REQUIRED: query (or alias q). Optional: action, tags, numeric_filters, hits_per_page, page. The daemon delivers this object as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList targetPortValue=input). Empty/missing query fails with output.error='query is required.' before any HTTP call. Example: {"query":"workflow","action":"search_by_date","tags":"story","page":0,"hits_per_page":30}.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Search query string sent as Algolia `query`. REQUIRED unless alias `q` is set (handler uses query, then q). Empty/missing both → output.error 'query is required.' Searches titles, URLs, story text, and comment text depending on tags. Not an HTTP URL. Example: 'workflow engine'. Example: 'automation rate limit'.

schema.label: action
schema.description: Which Algolia endpoint to call. EXACT accepted values: 'search' | 'search_by_date' (case-sensitive). Default when omitted/empty: 'search' → GET http://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search (relevance ranking). 'search_by_date' → GET http://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date (recency, most recent first). Any other string still hits /search (not an error). Example: 'search'. Example recency: 'search_by_date'.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Algolia `tags` filter. Default when omitted/empty: 'story'. EXACT tokens (use as-is): 'story', 'comment', 'show_hn', 'ask_hn', 'poll', 'front_page'. Author/story filters: 'author_USERNAME' (replace USERNAME, e.g. 'author_pg'), 'story_ID' (replace ID with the numeric HN item id, e.g. 'story_12345678'). Combinations: comma = AND ('story,show_hn', 'story,author_pg'); parentheses = OR ('(story,comment)', '(show_hn,ask_hn)'). Mixed: 'author_pg,(story,comment)'. Example front page: 'front_page'. Example comments on a thread: 'comment,story_123'.

schema.label: numeric_filters
schema.description: Optional Algolia `numericFilters` expression. Omitted/empty/falsey is not sent. Fields: points, num_comments, created_at_i (Unix timestamp seconds). Operators: <, <=, >, >=, =. Multiple comma-separated clauses are ANDed. Use created_at_i ranges to stay under the ~1,000-hit pagination ceiling. Example high-signal: 'points>100,num_comments>50'. Example last 24h (replace the timestamp): 'created_at_i>1700000000'. Example window: 'created_at_i>1700000000,created_at_i<1700086400'.

schema.label: hits_per_page
schema.description: Algolia `hitsPerPage` for this call. Optional. When omitted, configuration default_hits_per_page is used (default 30). The handler sends min(hits_per_page, 50) — 50 is the hard cap. Accepted values: integers. Example: 10. Example max page: 50. Values above 50 are clamped to 50; they are not rejected.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Algolia `page` index. 0-indexed (page 0 is the first page, not 1). Default: 0. Optional. Accepted values: integers >= 0. Combined with hits_per_page this is offset pagination; Algolia typically will not return hits past the first 1,000 matches (page * hits_per_page < 1000). Example first page: 0. Example second page: 1. Do not send 1 expecting the first page.

ports.name: output
ports.description: On success: status='ok' plus total_hits (Algolia nbHits), total_pages (nbPages), stories_returned, stories[]. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on success only. EXACT accepted value: 'ok' (the Algolia call returned HTTP 2xx and hits were mapped). Absent when output.error is set. Use this as the success gate together with a missing error key. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Total Hits
schema.description: Algolia nbHits: reported total matches for this query+tags+numericFilters. Integer. May exceed 1,000 even though later pages are empty — treat values above ~1000 as a ceiling signal and narrow with created_at_i. Not the same as stories_returned (that is this page only). Example: 842. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Total Pages
schema.description: Algolia nbPages for the current hitsPerPage. Integer. Page indexes run 0 .. total_pages-1. Because of the ~1,000-hit ceiling, total_pages may not be fully walkable. Example: 28. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Stories Returned
schema.description: Length of the stories array on this response page (after mapping hits). Integer 0..hits_per_page. Can be 0 on a valid ok response (no matches, or a page past the ceiling). Example: 30. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Stories
schema.description: Mapped Algolia hits for this page, in API order. Each element is an object with object_id, title (title or story_title or ''), url, points, num_comments, author, created_at, story_text (truncated to 500 chars), comment_text (truncated to 500 chars), hn_url ('https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id={objectID}'). Empty array when there are no hits. Absent on failure. Example item: {"object_id":"123","title":"Show HN: …","url":"https://…","points":42,"num_comments":7,"author":"pg","created_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","story_text":"","comment_text":"","hn_url":"https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=123"}.

children.label: object_id
children.description: Algolia objectID of the item (HN item id as a string). Used to build hn_url. Empty string when the hit omitted objectID. Example: '39926122'.

children.label: title
children.description: Display title: hit.title if non-empty, else hit.story_title, else ''. Comments often have a null title and a story_title of the parent submission. Example: 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?'.

children.label: url
children.description: External article URL from the hit, or '' for text-only Ask/Show posts and most comments. This is not the HN discussion URL (see hn_url). Example: 'https://example.com/blog'.

children.label: points
children.description: HN score (upvotes). Integer; 0 when the hit omitted points (common on some comment records). Example: 256.

children.label: num_comments
children.description: Comment count on the submission. Integer; 0 when omitted (typical for comment hits). Example: 84.

children.label: author
children.description: HN username of the item author. Empty string when omitted. Example: 'pg'.

children.label: created_at
children.description: Algolia created_at timestamp string (typically ISO-8601 UTC). Empty string when omitted. Example: '2026-03-15T12:04:00.000Z'. For numeric filters use created_at_i (Unix seconds), not this field.

children.label: story_text
children.description: Self-post body text, truncated to 500 characters (no ellipsis). Empty string when the hit has no story_text. Example: first 500 chars of an Ask HN body.

children.label: comment_text
children.description: Comment HTML/text, truncated to 500 characters (no ellipsis). Empty string for story hits. Example: first 500 chars of a comment when tags includes 'comment'.

children.label: hn_url
children.description: Canonical HN discussion URL: 'https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id={objectID}'. Always https. Built even when object_id is empty (then '...id='). Example: 'https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39926122'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds (connect+read) for the Algolia GET. Default: 25. Accepted values: positive integers. 0 or negative fall back to 25. Example: 25. Example for a slow path: 45. On expiry output.error is 'HackerNews Algolia API Error: timed out after {n}s'. Keep this at or below the daemon sandbox request budget.

configurationParameters.label: Default Hits Per Page
configurationParameters.description: Default Algolia hitsPerPage when input.hits_per_page is omitted. Range: 1-50. Default: 30. The handler still clamps the value sent to min(n, 50). Example: 30. Example compact pages: 10. Instance-editable so a workflow can lower payload size without changing every input.
